verdict.rationale: Expensify documents native connections to QuickBooks Online and NetSuite, and lists Xero among its integrations. QBO gets a daily chart-of-accounts sync and automatic export of finalized reports, and the product advertises multi-level GL coding. However, the evidence does not document user-controlled mapping of GL accounts, classes, and departments in these connections. missing for 10: explicit documentation of class/department and GL mapping controls per connector, Xero-specific connection docs, independent hands-on corroboration of sync and mapping behavior.

support.subject: As a finance lead, transactions sync to QuickBooks, NetSuite, or Xero with GL account, class, and department mappings I control

citations.quote: Daily sync updates your chart of accounts, customers/projects, and bank accounts. Finalized reports are exported automatically to QuickBooks Online.
Connect your Expensify Workspace to NetSuite to streamline expense syncing, reporting, and accounting.
45+ integrations. QuickBooks, NetSuite, Sage Intacct, Xero, Workday, Gusto, and so much more.
